items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I worked on a bill with Daphne Ruban Hellman

ctx.x: A tight arrangement and not only that, they wrote in some fill-ins for her because my music as its written is just sort of a basic accompaniment and she didn't play the figures that were written for the orchestra, they wrote some special figures in and, you know, she was playing a lot of that. That wasn't bad, but all I did was stick to the melody. We were not swinging and I've heard some of the -- I worked on a bill with Daphne Ruban Hellman at the Le Bleu for a while. She appeared,
